wizard.need_code: This bot has no owner yet. Send /start <code> — the one-time code is printed in the bot log (docker logs).
wizard.bad_code: Wrong code. Check the bot log (docker logs) and send /start <code> again.
wizard.owner_set: ✅ You are the owner of this bot.
wizard.add_to_group:
Next step:
1. Create a Telegram group and turn on Topics in its settings.
2. Add this bot to the group.
3. Make the bot an admin with “Manage topics” and “Delete messages”.
The bot will create the “Control” topic by itself; then send /add there.
wizard.private_help: The bot works in its group: open the “Control” topic and use /add or the buttons. Language: /lang
wizard.other_group: This bot is already bound to another group.
wizard.group_needs: To finish setup the group needs:
wizard.need_topics_right: • the admin right “Manage topics” for the bot
wizard.need_delete_right: • the admin right “Delete messages” for the bot (camera passwords are deleted right after reading)
wizard.group_retry: Fix it and send /setup here — or just promote the bot, I will notice.
wizard.group_ready: ✅ Group is ready: the “Control” topic is created. Add a camera there with /add.
wizard.group_already: The group is already set up. Cameras: /menu, new camera: /add.
wizard.console_ready: 👋 This is the control panel. Add your first camera: /add — I will search the network for ONVIF/RTSP cameras. A camera outside the search: /add rtsp://address:port/path
console.title: Control
add.searching: Searching the network for cameras — the list will appear in “Control”.
add.bad_address: Address not recognised. Send an IP (192.0.2.64), IP:RTSP-port or a full rtsp://host:port/path; optionally a second rtsp:// for the detector stream.
add.no_password_in_url: Send the address without login and password — I will ask for them separately and delete that message right away.
add.ask_address:
✍️ Send the camera address in one message: IP, IP:port or rtsp://host:port/path (optionally a second rtsp:// — a low-resolution stream for the detector).
I will wait 5 minutes.
add.manual_hint: Camera not found? Enter its address: button below or /add rtsp://host:port/path
add.first_frame: 📷 First frame of “{title}” is sent to its topic. Thresholds are set automatically from scene noise.
add.no_first_frame: Camera {camera_id} is registered, but there is no video from it for 2 minutes. Check the address and the camera; status — 🔄 in its topic.
error.not_found: Camera not found in the registry.
error.timeout: Bridge did not respond in time.
error.unavailable: Video surveillance service is temporarily unavailable.
error.clip_window_empty: This moment has already left the buffer — the clip cannot be built.
error.default: Could not complete: video surveillance failure.
health.detector_stalled: 🟠 Detector is silent: heartbeat is stale. Motion is not being detected now.
health.detector_blind: 🟠 Detector receives no frames. Motion is not being detected now.
health.detector_disabled: 🟠 Detector is off. Motion is not being detected now.
bridge.down: 🔴 Video surveillance: the engine is not responding — frames, clips and detection are not working now.
bridge.up: 🟢 Video surveillance: the engine is responding again.
hint.unknown: Use the buttons in a camera topic. Camera list: /menu
input.rename:
✏️ Send the new camera name in one message.
I will wait for it in this topic for {minutes} minutes.
input.retire:
🗑 Retiring will close the camera topic.
To confirm, send in one message: retire
input.drop:
🗑 Deleting removes the camera from the bridge registry together with its address and password.
To confirm, send in one message: delete
input.creds:
🔑 Camera {host}: send “login password” in one message.
I will delete the message right after reading it.
setup.no_record: The registry returned no record for this camera.
setup.title: Settings of “{title}”
setup.login: Login: {value} (the password is stored only by the bridge)
setup.card_sent: The settings card is in the camera topic.
callback.wrong_topic: This button does not belong to this topic.
add.searching_here: Searching the network for cameras — I will show the list here.
keyboard.camera_topic_only: This button works in a camera topic.
keyboard.open_topic: Open a camera topic — the control buttons work there.
keyboard.pinned: Control buttons for “{title}” are pinned below.
frame.unknown: This is not a camera frame or it is older than an hour — the moment can no longer be matched with the buffer. You can get a clip around a fresh frame: press 📷 Frame in the camera topic.
frame.expired: The clip request period for this frame has expired. Clips are built from a ring buffer of a few minutes — request a new frame: 📷 Frame.
frame.other_topic: This frame belongs to another camera topic.
control.paused: Camera paused: motion events are off, the buttons still work.
drop.done: Camera deleted from the bridge registry together with its address and password. Topic closed.
rename.empty_retry: The name cannot be empty — send it again.
scan.searching: Searching for cameras in {networks}. This takes up to a minute.
scan.bridge_timeout: the bridge did not respond in time.
scan.none_new: No new cameras found. Already in the registry: {known}.
scan.none: No cameras found on the network: no address with RTSP or ONVIF.
scan.found: New cameras found: {fresh} (already in the registry: {known}).
scan.pick: Choose a camera — next I will ask for the login and password.
creds.no_host: I do not know the camera address — start with a search.
creds.need_both: I need the login and password in one message: “login password”. I have already deleted what you sent — send it again.
creds.failed: {error} Send “login password” again or reopen the control panel.
creds.ask_name:
{detected}
Send the camera name in one message — I will register it under that name.
add.added:
Camera “{title}” registered (camera_id: {camera_id}). The pipeline is restarting — the topic with its panel will appear within half a minute.
Person detection is off for a new camera: turn it on in “⚙️ Settings” once you have looked at the scene.
detect.enabled: Person detection on, the pipeline is restarting.
detect.disabled: Person detection off: events will be based on motion.
detected.no_snapshot: none (a frame from the stream will be used)
detected.not_verified: ⚠️ The stream at this address did not open during the check.
detected.template: Parameters were guessed from typical addresses: the camera did not provide them via ONVIF.
media.snap_requested: Request sent, the frame will arrive in the topic.
delivery.failed:
⚠️ {caption}
Media not delivered after {attempts} attempts ({error}). The event was left unrecorded.
storage.warning: ⚠️ Bridge storage: {used} of {budget} used, {free} free on disk. Event clips may stop being recorded.
menu.footer: Control with the buttons below and in the pinned message of the camera topic.
model.menu_sent: The detector model menu is in “Control”.
model.menu_here: Detector model — the menu is below.
model.files_here: Model files — the list is below.
model.active_none: Active: none — person detection waits for a working model.
model.files_none: No model files found. Put an ONNX file into models/ of the config directory (see docs/models.md).
model.last_rollback: ⚠️ Last switch to {family} — {file} failed ({reason}) and was rolled back.
model.pick_file: {family}: pick the model file. After the switch the threshold is {confidence:.2f} — the family start value. ⚠️ — the file name suggests another family.
model.no_files: {family}: no model files found. Put the ONNX file into models/ of the config directory (see docs/models.md) and open /model again.
model.switching: Loading {family} — {file}. The current model keeps working until the new one is ready.
model.switched:
✅ Detector model: {family} — {file}, threshold {confidence:.2f}.
Detection did not stop: frames and events in the queue were processed by the previous model up to the switch and by the new one after it.
model.superseded: The switch to {file} was replaced by a newer request.
model.timeout:
The engine did not confirm the switch in {seconds} s (is the engine running?).
{active}
model.error.person_model_family_mismatch: the file is of another family (different network output)
model.error.person_model_load_failed: the file is not a readable ONNX model
thr.menu_here: Detector thresholds — the list is below.
thr.line_auto: • {title}: {threshold:.2f} — auto (background noise {noise:.2f} over {frames} frames, confirmed passes used: {passes})
thr.pending: ⏳ Calibration requested, waiting for the engine…
thr.explain: Auto-calibration runs after a model switch and on “Calibrate”: it puts the threshold above the background noise of the scene, never above the confirmed passes. It cannot tell how many people are missed (recall) without labelled people — if a camera misses passes, set its threshold manually.
thr.calibrating: Calibration started: {frames} background frames per camera. The current threshold keeps working until it finishes; the result will be in “🎯 Thresholds”.
thr.ask: Send the threshold for {title}: a number from {min:.2f} to {max:.2f} (now {threshold:.2f}). Send “auto” to remove the manual threshold.
thr.set_done: ✅ Threshold for {title}: {value:.2f} (manual, for {model}). It survives restarts and stops applying when the model is switched.
thr.auto_done: ✅ Manual threshold for {title} removed, now {threshold:.2f} (auto-calibration or the model start threshold).
thr.bad_value: That is not a threshold: send a number from {min:.2f} to {max:.2f} or “auto”.
